title: Large-Scale Application / Lobby Current
slide_intent: Adjust pace and scale for the viewer’s surroundings so movement can inhabit a space without overwhelming it.
strategic_value: A slower current can carry Spectrum’s identity into an architectural encounter while retaining the blue-and-green signature.
demonstration: A 45.03-second visualization shows three tall lobby screens with slowly changing line fields, a Spectrum Life Unlimited lockup on the middle screen and a human figure for scale.
practical_value: Judge movement against human scale and neighboring screens before translating a short logo animation into an installation.

content_islands.name: Architectural frame
content_islands.spec: Place three tall screen recesses in a white room, retain floor reflections and a small figure at the left screen for scale.

content_islands.name: Current choreography
content_islands.spec: Let the curved line families move through and across the three screen fields while the middle screen carries the identity.

ingredient.name: Architectural current
ingredient.role: Animate a large environment while preserving a recognizable brand presence.
ingredient.application: Use slower, graceful movement for the large lobby installation and allow the expanded palette supplied for that setting.
ingredient.scope: The agency describes 6K lobby screens. This local video is a case-study visualization, not a 6K production asset.
